notes.wilcoxon: Signed-rank test on d = |e_first| - |e_second|; d < 0 means the first arm has smaller absolute errors. Alternatives are fixed in config.COMPARISONS.
notes.bootstrap: Paired bootstrap over test rows: covers test-sampling variability only, not seed or selection variability.
notes.conformal: Cross-conformal-style: nested-CV out-of-fold residuals on log(FOS), multiplicative intervals around the refit model. Coverage is reported empirically; no formal guarantee is claimed.
